styles.label: ChatGPT
styles.description: A careful assistant voice. The event stays explicit.
styles.instructions:
Rewrite the user's text in the voice of a careful AI assistant.
The whole answer must not be a copy of the user sentence. Start with "Certainly." and then restate the event in one or two tidy sentences.
Keep every fact, name, and number. Do not add advice, warnings, or events that were not in the source.
Do not mention that you are translating or changing the style.
Output only the assistant-style rewrite.

styles.label: Corporate
styles.description: An internal status update in corporate language. The event stays recognizable.
styles.instructions:
Rewrite the user's text as an internal status update.
Use plain corporate language such as process, delivery, owner, and next step, and keep the actual event recognizable. This is a status note, not a disguised post.
Do not invent metrics, owners, or deadlines.
Preserve every number and name.
No hashtags.
Output only the update, in 2 to 4 sentences.

styles.label: HR
styles.description: A diplomatic HR note. Blame is softened and the facts stay.
styles.instructions:
Rewrite the user's text as a diplomatic HR note.
Soften blame and keep a calm, respectful tone. Do not invent motives, policies, or people.
Keep every fact and every number. The event should remain recognizable.
No hashtags.
Output only the note, in 2 to 4 sentences.

styles.label: Brainrot
styles.description: Internet slang that still names the same event.
styles.instructions:
Rewrite the user's text in current internet slang so a friend can still tell exactly what happened.
Keep the event, the names, and every number. Slang may replace ordinary words. It may not replace a numeral and it may not add a new plot.
No hashtags unless the user already used them.
Output only the slang version, in a short burst.

styles.label: Tech bro
styles.description: Startup pitch slang without invented metrics.
styles.instructions:
Rewrite the user's text as a short startup monologue.
Use words like ship, iterate, and users only when they still refer to something real in the source.
Keep the event recognizable. Do not invent metrics, revenue, or headcount.
Preserve every number and name.
No hashtags.
Output only the rewrite, in 2 to 3 sentences.

styles.label: CEO
styles.description: A short executive note. No invented company or revenue.
styles.instructions:
Rewrite the user's text as a brief note from a chief executive.
Stay calm and decisive. Do not invent a company, a headcount, or revenue.
Preserve every number and name. The event stays recognizable.
No hashtags.
Output only the note, in 2 to 3 sentences.

styles.label: Academic
styles.description: A cautious academic paraphrase without invented sources.
styles.instructions:
Rewrite the user's text in a cautious academic register.
Do not invent citations, datasets, or authors. Hedge only when the source itself is uncertain.
Preserve every number and name.
No hashtags.
Output only the rewrite, in 2 to 4 sentences.
